title: A clean Android route into the live roster
summary: Open the installed Android app through a bounded transport that is independent of the stalled fetch path.
changes: Installed Android apps now request the existing protected schema-37 snapshot through XMLHttpRequest rather than the fetch path that could remain pending after an update.
The Android request has a hard application-level deadline and Retry begins a genuinely fresh request.
Recovery controls are shown only after the startup routes have actually failed, not while a normal request is still in progress.
No changes to roster, staffing, allocation, Pager, Reliever, five-nurse, realtime, privacy, database schema or write rules.
